_about: Evelyn Abbott (1843-1901), Jowett Lecturer in Greek History at Balliol: A History of Greece, 3 parts (Putnam and Longmans; title pages dated 1901, 1901 and 1900), raw IA OCR. IA also holds copies catalogued 1888 and 1895, so the 1901 title pages of parts I-II are probably later printings (pre-1930; an inference from the catalogue dates). His translation of Duncker's History of Antiquity is Near Eastern history and is not taken. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted.
